title: Hearing Dusen, Farnish and excursion bands, and Alexander's Ragtime Band
summary: He heard Dusen and Farnish only in the city; excursion bands were the big music at home, where he first heard Alexander's Ragtime Band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You remember Frankie Doosen ever went down in the country that way? Did you work with him?
He was playing with Allen, too. He was one of the fellas playing with Allen at that time.
Did he ever come down there in a dance band or anything?
No, I never seen him in a dance band, but I came up here and hear them play in a dance band. At the...
Do you remember ever hearing Willie Farnish in a dance band down there in the country anywhere else?

No, I heard him up here. I heard him up here. I didn't hear him, no. I needed to do it. The only... We didn't have no big dances at my home. The Excursion bands used to come out there. You see, when they had the band Excursion, that's the only big band. Sometimes White would come by there, too. I heard a band playing... The first time I heard that was a long time ago.

Yeah, and I loved Liza, you know, and they played that about... You see, they take water at the place where it was. And I went up and I said, what's the name of that piece? He told me. Alexander Right Time Band. And that ain't been the date. That's an old number. That's an old number.
